text: 下面进入小作文 01 · 建议信：图书馆设施与自习服务优化，英式思维与留白盲拼训练。
【首段开口 · 身份 + 目的】不要写 I want to give you some advice。请用 As a senior 定从自我介绍，并换用精准搭配提出建议：
As a senior at this university who spends considerable time reading in the library, I am writing to offer constructive suggestions on improving its current facilities and services.
手术刀点拨：offer constructive suggestions 替换 give advice；定语从句紧跟身份词，迅速建立写信合法性。
【二段核心 · 形式主语 + , which】写给图书馆长提建议，不要说 I think you should open longer。请改为下对上礼貌虚拟 + 挂载结果：
First and foremost, it would be deeply appreciated if the library could extend its opening hours during exam weeks, which would greatly facilitate students' revision.
手术刀点拨：it would be deeply appreciated if 语气极得体，后半句用 , which would greatly facilitate 挂载成果，消灭流水逗号。
【二段升华 · 倒装双叠加】改写“这些小调整看似简单，但不仅提升效率还能体现关怀”：
Simple as these adjustments may seem, not only can they enhance daily study efficiency, but they also reflect greater care for student needs.
手术刀拆解：句首 Simple as ... may seem 接 not only can 倒装，用 can 保住 enhance 原形，杜绝单三遗漏。
